items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: We had two of the Syncopated Orchestra, and -- three of the Syncopated Orchestra, with Salnave, the flutist... And we played at the Murray's Club.

ctx.x: We went to Oslo for three months and after the three months we came back, we went back to London, and then the band, we folded then.
